stories.title: Egypt defeats Saudi real estate investors’ mega-claim
stories.summary: Egypt has defeated claims worth more than US$34 billion brought by Saudi real estate investors under the OIC investment agreement, after a divided tribunal said the state’s consent to arbitrate could not be imported from another treaty using a most-favoured nation clause.
stories.story: Egypt has defeated claims worth more than US$34 billion brought by Saudi real estate investors under the OIC investment agreement, after a divided tribunal said the state’s consent to arbitrate could not be imported from another treaty using a most-favoured nation clause.

stories.title: US tech company gets fraud suit sent to arbitration
stories.summary: A US data cloud company has won its bid to compel arbitration of a US$100 million lawsuit lodged by a former employee over an alleged fraud involving a cryptocurrency venture.
